source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily close via yfinance
method: Last adjusted close of month / last adjusted close of prior month - 1; completed months only; no fees or taxes.

summary.zh: 把所有年份放在一起看，SPY 和 QQQ 在这段时间平均都是上涨。各年的表现仍有差别，可以对照下方的涨跌次数和最好、最差年份。
summary.en: SPY and QQQ both averaged a gain over this period. Results varied by year, as the up and down counts and the best and worst years show.

summary.zh: 把所有年份放在一起看，SPY 和 QQQ 在这段时间平均都是下跌。结合涨跌次数和最差年份，可以看出下跌有多常见、跌幅有多大。
summary.en: SPY and QQQ both averaged a loss over this period. The counts and worst years show how often prices fell and how large those declines could be.

summary.zh: SPY 和 QQQ 在这段时间的平均结果方向不同。分别看两个指数的涨跌幅和涨跌次数，比笼统地说「美股涨了」或「美股跌了」更准确。
summary.en: SPY and QQQ had different average outcomes over this period. Read each fund’s returns and up and down counts separately.
